## Checklist

- [ ] `make verify` passes
- [ ] PR title is a Conventional Commit header (`type(scope): title`)
- [ ] No private content (names, hosts, project keys, internal links)
- [ ] Every third-party action is pinned by full commit SHA with a `# vX.Y.Z` comment
- [ ] README updated if a workflow's inputs, secrets or check names changed
